verdict.rationale: DBOS documents sending messages to a specific running workflow via DBOS.send(), with optional topics queued per receiver, and the workflow waits durably with DBOS.recv(timeout) for human-in-the-loop signals. DBOSClient lets external code or another DBOS application interact with the app, which covers the API-call and cross-workflow cases. Missing for 10: an explicit example of DBOSClient sending a message from an API or webhook handler, evidence of an event-publishing primitive beyond messages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
